description: Archive an active Brand to soft-hide it from default pickers and list queries without losing styling tokens. Call to declutter workspace brands. Do NOT use for permanent deletion; use delete_brand instead. Idempotent state transition, fully reversible via restore_brand. Existing slideshow runs referencing this brand continue to display correctly. Returns updated Brand with status set to archived.

brandId.description: The unique identifier of the brand to archive.

name: archive_brand
title: Archive brand
